headline: Hurricanes activate Seth Jarvis off injured reserve
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that the Hurricanes have activated Seth Jarvis off injured reserve. Carolina also called up forward Skyler Brind'Amour and sent down forward Bradley Nadeau.

Jarvis comes back to a team that hasn't needed rescuing. Carolina is 8-2-1 for 17 points through 11 games, and it has controlled play so far this season. CAR has taken 61.5% of the expected goals, a measure of the quality of chances each side creates, and 58% at five-on-five. Its special teams look solid too: the power play generates 1.01 expected goals per game, while the penalty kill allows just 0.47 per game.

The one oddity is finishing. CAR has scored 2.8 fewer goals than its chances would suggest, so the record is probably a little short of what the play deserves. A healthy Jarvis adds another scoring option to a group already creating plenty, which is the easiest way to close that gap. The data here covers the team only, so how much he moves things on his own isn't something these numbers can show yet.
